Method of Attack: Remote command injection via HTTP interface exploiting unsanitized input in os.system call
Impacted Systems: Zyxel firewalls supporting Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) with firmware versions ZLD5.00 to ZLD5.21 Patch 1 including USG FLEX 50, 50W, 100W, 200, 500, 700; USG20-VPN and USG20W-VPN; ATP 100, 200, 500, 700, 800
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated remote command injection via /ztp/cgi-bin/handler URI using setWanPortSt command parameters (mtu or data)
Indicators of Compromise: Shodan results showing 16,213 vulnerable systems exposed to internet
